## AsrApi.warmUp() method

Bring the speech model up before it is needed, so a later openSession() does not pay the cold start. Resolves once the model is serving; safe to call without awaiting. Requires Transcription to be enabled in Moss but no per-tool consent, since no audio is involved.

**Signature:**

```typescript
warmUp(): Promise<void>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;void&gt;
